seo.title: Moof - Matcha & Hojicha, Tanjong Pagar
seo.description: Moof is a specialty matcha and hojicha bar in Singapore's CBD. Hand-whisked, ceremonial-grade drinks made slowly with Mori and Shiran matcha from Japan.
seo.menuDescription: The full Moof menu: core matcha and hojicha lattes, and the current seasonal drinks, with prices.

hero.headline: Matcha and hojicha, made slowly.
hero.supportingCopy: Moof is a small specialty bar for hand-whisked, ceremonial-grade matcha and hojicha - a quiet pause built into the middle of a CBD day.

ritual.heading: Two leaves, one process.
paragraphs: Matcha is sifted and hand-whisked to order. The menu pairs strong tea with fresh milk or oat milk, alongside a small rotating set of seasonal flavours.
We work with two matchas from Japan, chosen for what they bring to a cup rather than for novelty. Mori and Shiran sit at the centre of almost everything on the menu.

ingredients.name: Mori
ingredients.description: A deep green matcha with a rounded finish - the one we reach for when a drink needs richness and body.

ingredients.name: Shiran
ingredients.description: A smoother, cleaner profile, better suited to bright drinks and layered milk tea.

menuIntro.heading: A short list, kept honest.
menuIntro.supportingCopy: Four drinks on the counter every day, and a small seasonal set that changes with the months.

visit.heading: Come sit with us.
paragraphs: Moof is tucked into Eon Shenton, a short walk from the office towers along Shenton Way - an easy stop before work, between meetings, or on the way home.
A five-minute walk from Tanjong Pagar MRT station, if you're coming from further out.
visit.note: We're closed weekends - see you Monday.
